description: One data row of central/scenario_persons.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8.

cap.description: The person's spending cap in the scenario.

cost_ref.description: The person's position: month-to-date cost_ref at the end of the month.

excess.description: How far the position at the end of the month is over the cap or envelope; 0.00 if not over.

person_key.description: Pseudonymous person key: a keyed hash of the person id, stable for one hashing key.

scenario_id.description: Id of the shadow scenario from the policy.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

stopped_on.description: First day the position passed the cap or envelope; empty if it never did.

top_up_total.description: top_ups times the scenario's top-up amount.

top_ups.description: Number of top-up amounts needed to cover the excess.

title: gold-dataset-scenario_persons
x-cost-column-rule: `cost_ref` is the position at the end of the month, not a new cost; `excess` is not spend.
x-grain: One row per scenario, month and person with a cap.
